policy: A registered candidate is the only artifact the publisher may offer as a real submission. Registration requires byte hash, run card, holdout evidence and uniqueness evidence; everything unregistered stays DO NOT SUBMIT.

candidates.decision_basis: format validator passes on saved bytes; 4-fold whole-fault holdout measured; rank correlation vs 93 registry rasters max 0.565 (< 0.90); no leaderboard estimate is defensible (holdout-to-leaderboard LOO R2 < 0)

format validator passes on the saved bytes; pooled buffered-whole-segment holdout measured over 2 folds and 7,893 withheld positives (evaluator wbg4-edti-v1) at the 40k operating point; uniqueness measured against 437 registry rasters with 0 method-bearing violations (max 3 px overlap 0.5604, max |Spearman| 0.1665); no leaderboard score is defensible - the projection 0.20-0.30 is explicitly not a score, and the cross-lane evaluator difference makes the SSCC 0.1086 non-comparable
